implementation.name: original-v3-occ-worktrees
implementation.scope: Illustrative identities h0/h1/h2 and c1/c2/c3 on the original worktree, dependency, candidate, and publication diagram. Each head is a revision identity, not an elapsed-time measurement. Candidate checks and captured target identity travel together.
implementation.question: Why can a checked private change still fail publication?

purpose: Make semantic staleness, exact-candidate evidence, and failed compare-and-swap visible before successful revalidation and publication.
storyboard: Build a textually clean but stale candidate
Build candidate c2 against captured h1
Move the target head during review
Revalidate against the new target h2
Check that exact fresh candidate c3
Publish only the checked candidate at the captured head
guard: Textual merge success does not establish semantic correctness. Checks apply to the exact candidate they examined. Atomic publication must compare the captured target head; a moved head requires revalidation. Worktrees isolate files, not tool execution authority or external effects.
